045/**
046 * The HomeFragment class represents the main user interface component of the application.
047 * It is responsible for handling the navigation, permissions, and menu interactions within the app.
048 * This fragment is integrated with Android Hilt for dependency injection and utilizes multiple
049 * ViewModels for state management and logic handling.
050 */
051@AndroidEntryPoint
052public class HomeFragment extends Fragment implements MenuProvider, OnDismissListener {
053
054  private static final int PERMISSIONS_REQUEST_CODE = 674;
055  private static final String TAG = HomeFragment.class.getSimpleName();
056  private static final String[] permissionsNeeded = {ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
057      CAMERA};
058
059  private FragmentHomeBinding binding;
060  private LoginViewModel loginViewModel;
061  private PinViewModel pinViewModel;
062  private PermissionsViewModel permissionsViewModel;
063  private String[] permissionsToRequest;
064  /**
065   * @noinspection FieldCanBeLocal
066   */
067  private ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> requestPermissionsLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
068      new ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions(), this::handleGrantResults);
069  private NavController childNavController;
070  private NavController parentNavController;
071
072  @Override
073  public View onCreateView(
074      @NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, ViewGroup container, Bundle savedInstanceState) {
075    binding = FragmentHomeBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
076    return binding.getRoot();
077  }
078
079
080  @Override
081  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
082    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
083    LifecycleOwner lifecycleOwner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
084    FragmentActivity activity = requireActivity();
085    ViewModelProvider provider = new ViewModelProvider(activity);
086    loginViewModel = provider.get(LoginViewModel.class);
087    loginViewModel
088        .getAccount()
089        .observe(lifecycleOwner, (account) -> {
090          if (account == null) {
091            parentNavController.navigate(HomeFragmentDirections.navigateToPreLoginFragment());
092          } else {
093            Log.d(TAG,"displayname = " + account.getDisplayName());
094            Log.d(TAG,"OAuth key = " + account.getId());
095          }
096        });
097    permissionsViewModel = provider.get(PermissionsViewModel.class);
098    activity.addMenuProvider(this, getViewLifecycleOwner(), State.RESUMED);
099  }
100
101  @Override
102  public void onResume() {
103    super.onResume();
104    // TOD 3/28/25 Setup navigation connection. Connect the nav controller to the appbar and use
105    //  the nav UI class to use bottom button with NavController
106    childNavController =
107        ((NavHostFragment) binding.mapsPinsFragmentContainer.getFragment()).getNavController();
108    parentNavController = Navigation.findNavController(binding.getRoot());
109    NavigationUI.setupWithNavController(binding.bottomNavigation, childNavController);
110    setupPermissions();
111  }
112
113  @Override
114  public void onDestroyView() {
115    binding = null;
116    super.onDestroyView();
117  }
118
119  @Override
120  public void onCreateMenu(@NonNull Menu menu, @NonNull MenuInflater menuInflater) {
121    menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.main_actions, menu);
122  }
123
124  @Override
125  public boolean onMenuItemSelected(@NonNull MenuItem menuItem) {
126    boolean handled = true;
127    if (menuItem.getItemId() == R.id.sign_out) {
128      loginViewModel.signOut();
129    } else {
130      handled = false;
131    }
132    return handled;
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Sets up the app permissions workflow by determining which permissions need to be requested,
137   * collecting the permissions that are already granted, and handling the explanatory steps for
138   * permissions if necessary.
139   *
140   * The method performs the following operations:
141   * - Identifies permissions that still need to be requested based on their current status.
142   * - Updates the view model with the status of permissions that are already granted.
143   * - Checks if any of the permissions to be requested require an explanation to the user.
144   * - If explanations are required, navigates to an explanation fragment to inform the user about
145   *   the permissions. Otherwise, directly triggers the permission request process.
146   *
147   * This method interacts with the view model to maintain the state of permissions and uses
148   * navigation to guide the user through the permission flow.
149   */
150  private void setupPermissions() {
151    permissionsToRequest = Arrays.stream(permissionsNeeded)
152        .filter(this::shouldRequestPermission)
153        .toArray(String[]::new);
154    Map<String, Boolean> permissionsStatus = Arrays.stream(permissionsNeeded)
155        .filter(Predicate.not(this::shouldRequestPermission))
156        .collect(Collectors.toMap(Function.identity(), (permission) -> true));
157    permissionsViewModel.updatePermissionsStatus(permissionsStatus);
158    String[] permissionsToExplain = Arrays.stream(permissionsToRequest)
159        .filter(this::shouldExplainPermission)
160        .toArray(String[]::new);
161    if (permissionsToExplain.length > 0) {
162      parentNavController.navigate(
163          LoginFragmentDirections.openExplanationFragment(permissionsToExplain));
164    } else {
165      onDismiss();
166    }
167  }
168
169  /**
170   * Handles the results of permission requests and updates the permissions status in the view model.
171   *
172   * @param grantResults A map containing the permissions requested and their corresponding
173   *                     grant results, where the key is the permission name, and the value is
174   *                     a boolean indicating whether the permission was granted (true) or denied (false).
175   */
176  public void handleGrantResults(@NonNull Map<String, Boolean> grantResults) {
177    Log.d(TAG, grantResults.toString());
178    permissionsViewModel.updatePermissionsStatus(grantResults);
179  }
180
181  @Override
182  public void onDismiss() {
183    requestPermissionsLauncher.launch(permissionsToRequest);
184  }
185
186  /**
187   * Determines whether the specified permission should be requested by checking if it is already granted.
188   *
189   * @param permission The name of the permission to check (e.g., android.permission.CAMERA).
190   * @return {@code true} if the specified permission is not granted and should be requested, {@code false} otherwise.
191   */
192  private boolean shouldRequestPermission(String permission) {
193    return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(), permission)
194        != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
195  }
196
197  /**
198   * Checks whether an explanation should be shown to the user for the specified permission.
199   * This is typically used to determine if rationale should be provided before requesting a permission.
200   *
201   * @param permission The name of the permission to check (e.g., android.permission.CAMERA).
202   * @return {@code true} if an explanation should be shown to the user for the specified permission,
203   *         {@code false} otherwise.
204   */
205  private boolean shouldExplainPermission(String permission) {
206    return ActivityCompat.shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(requireActivity(), permission);
207  }
208
209}
